instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin at a slow pace and steadily accelerate your speech throughout the sentence, finishing at a very fast speed.
text: Круговорот воды в природе представляет собой сложный и непрерывный процесс, в ходе которого вода испаряется с поверхности океанов и суши, поднимается в атмосферу, конденсируется в облака и в конечном итоге возвращается на землю в виде осадков, питая реки и озёра.

target_values.speed: start slow, gradually accelerate to very fast

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speech does not start at a slow pace and does not accelerate. It maintains a consistently fast pace from beginning to end.

instruction_evidence.speed: The audio begins at a fast pace and stays fast, completely failing to follow the requested progression from slow to very fast.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable due to poor instruction following.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable due to poor instruction following.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this with a steady crescendo, beginning almost inaudibly and ending with a powerful, loud voice.
text: Сначала был только шепот надежды, потом он перерос в уверенный голос, а теперь это крик целого народа, который требует перемен!

target_values.volume: begin very quiet and build up to very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to execute the requested steady crescendo. It begins at a normal-to-loud volume instead of almost inaudibly, and the volume remains mostly flat throughout.

instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The requested crescendo from very quiet to very loud is absent. The entire speech is delivered at a fairly consistent, loud volume.
instruction_evidence.initial_volume: Does not begin 'almost inaudibly'; starts clearly and loudly.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Your voice should start low and neutral, then rise in pitch as you become worried, and end high and fearful.
text: Я смотрел на экран монитора, как вдруг он мигнул и погас, а затем из динамиков раздался тихий, искаженный голос.

target_values.pitch: start low and rise to high
target_values.emotion: from neutral to worried, then to fearful

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The pitch progression from low to high is clearly audible, but the emotional progression fails. The ending sounds artificially high-pitched rather than genuinely fearful.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The voice starts in a low register and noticeably rises in pitch throughout the sentence, ending high as requested.
instruction_evidence.emotional_progression: The initial neutral tone is present, but the transition to worry and particularly fear is unconvincing. The ending lacks fearful characteristics and sounds merely artificially pitched up.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin speaking quickly and with conviction, but let your voice trail off, becoming slow and hesitant by the end of the sentence.
text: Нет никаких сомнений в том, что это правильное решение для компании, оно принесет нам огромную прибыль... если, конечно, рынок отреагирует так, как мы предполагаем.

target_values.speed: start fast and then slow down to a crawl
target_values.tone: begin with a firm tone that becomes hesitant

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker starts quickly and with conviction, but completely fails to slow down or sound hesitant in the second half, resulting in a flattened dynamic progression.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The audio begins with a fast pace, but the speed remains consistently fast until the end, failing to slow down.
instruction_evidence.tone_progression: The initial firm tone is audible, but the requested hesitation and trailing off in the final clause are absent.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off loud, fast, and angry. Then, transition into a sad tone, slowing down and getting quieter. End the sentence in a slow, quiet, thoughtful manner.
text: Почему ты никогда меня не слушал, я же столько раз говорил тебе об этом, а теперь уже слишком поздно что-то менять, и остается только принять это.

target_values.emotion: start angry, then transition to sad, and end on a thoughtful note

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio maintains a fast, loud, and highly agitated tone throughout the entire sentence. It completely fails to transition into a sad, slow, or quiet tone, and does not end in a thoughtful manner.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speech is extremely fast from start to finish, with no audible slowing down.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume remains loud and intense throughout, never becoming quiet.
instruction_evidence.emotion: The delivery is consistently desperate or panicked; there is no progression to sad or thoughtful.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Switch back and forth between a pleading and a defiant tone as you read the different phrases in this sentence.
text: Я умоляю тебя, пойми меня, но я никогда не соглашусь на это; неужели ты не видишь, ведь это мое окончательное решение.

target_values.tone: alternate between a pleading tone and a defiant tone

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is entirely flat and monotone, with no audible switching between pleading and defiant tones.

instruction_evidence.pleading_tone: The phrases that should sound pleading are delivered with a flat, robotic tone.
instruction_evidence.defiant_tone: There is no shift to a defiant tone; the voice remains monotone throughout.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this in three stages: first, speak normally; second, become very slow, low-pitched and quiet; third, suddenly become very fast, high-pitched and loud.
text: Я шел по темному коридору, и вдруг в самом конце я увидел, как под дверью медленно пробивается тонкий лучик света... и внезапно дверь распахнулась!

target_values.pitch: normal, then drops to very low, then suddenly very high
target_values.speed: normal, then very slow, then suddenly very fast
target_values.volume: normal, then very quiet, then suddenly very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the dynamic progression. While the second stage is slightly slower, it is not significantly quieter or lower-pitched. The third stage completely fails, remaining slow and flat rather than suddenly becoming fast, high-pitched, and loud.

instruction_evidence.stage_1_normal: The beginning is spoken with a normal pitch, speed, and volume.
instruction_evidence.stage_2_slow_low_quiet: The middle section becomes slightly slower but lacks the requested low pitch and very quiet volume.
instruction_evidence.stage_3_fast_high_loud: The final section is delivered slowly with pauses between words, failing entirely to become fast, high-pitched, or loud.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin speaking in a happy and playful tone, but about halfway through, shift to a sad and disappointed tone.
text: О, я выиграл билеты на концерт, как здорово, мы так давно хотели пойти... ой, подожди, это же на прошлую неделю.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio exhibits a slight shift in pacing and pitch between the two halves, but the requested emotional states (happy/playful and sad/disappointed) are extremely flattened and weak.

instruction_evidence.happy_playful_start: The first half is spoken slightly faster and with a higher pitch, but it lacks genuine happy or playful expression, sounding mostly neutral.
instruction_evidence.sad_disappointed_end: The second half slows down and drops in pitch, but it fails to convey true sadness or disappointment, resulting in a very weak and incomplete emotional progression.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds highly synthetic and robotic with unnatural prosody.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is monotonous and lacks meaningful emotional range or shaping.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off by giving the instructions quickly and with an urging tone, then slow down and shift into a complaining tone as you finish.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Recount this story in a surprised and excited tone, letting your volume and pitch fluctuate throughout, getting louder and higher on the most unbelievable parts.
text: Ты не поверишь, я иду по улице, и вдруг вижу огромную толпу, а в центре стоит слон, представляешь, настоящий живой слон!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the surprised and excited tone. The volume and pitch fluctuate dynamically throughout the sentence and noticeably peak on the most unbelievable parts, demonstrating excellent progression.

instruction_evidence.emotion: The tone is clearly surprised and highly excited right from the beginning.
instruction_evidence.dynamic_progression: Volume and pitch increase significantly at 'огромную толпу', 'в центре стоит слон', and 'настоящий живой слон', closely matching the instruction to get louder and higher on the unbelievable parts.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The slight laugh at the beginning and the breathy, enthusiastic delivery make the speech sound incredibly natural and human-like.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, with excellent pacing, emphasis, and emotional shaping that strongly elevate the storytelling.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin your speech with a loud, high-pitched, and happy voice. Gradually let your voice become quieter, lower in pitch, and emotionally neutral as if you are running out of steam.

target_values.pitch: start high and gradually fall to low
